words: We make games that feel like
Twelve people making small, warm, handmade worlds. Three games, two awards, and one office dog named Pixel.

We started in a kitchen in 2019 with one idea: games should make people feel good. We still work four-day weeks, we still ship when it's ready, and we still argue about the best pastel de nata in town.
